cherokee: sogwili tla yudulisge unago'isdi sogwili uniyvsdi'i
english: The horse doesn't want to leave the barn (horse stables)

cherokee: gohigv tsigesv sogwili otsinatla'v usdi dudo'v
english: A while ago, we had a horse named 'Usdi'

cherokee: usdi sogwili gesv'i
english: She was a small horse

cherokee: iga udanti gesv
english: She was really nice

cherokee: nani'vgwu kilo unadulisgv unakilvdodi hi'a sogwili
english: Everybody wanted to ride this horse

cherokee: asehno iga uwasa gvkilvdodi gesv
english: But only in the day was it possible to ride her

cherokee: yitsaduli hiyakilvdodi usv yig tla eli yiganvgo [yigananugo] gesv sogwili uniyvsdiyi
english: If you wanted to ride her at night, it wouldn't be possible for her to come out of the barn

cherokee: igawu gesv hyanehlda gesv tla eli yiganvgo gesv'i
english: No matter how hard you try, it isn't possible to get her out

cherokee: ayehligwu iyv iga ganida'dv
english: Her tail only comes half way.

cherokee: Nasgihno iyusdi ogadlanvdadehv gogi yigi sogwili uniyvsdi na'v yedo'a usdi otsego ale tvhgi dotsidehiho yigvwadetohda
english: That's why when we had time in the summer and she was by the barn we'd go to her and swat the flies that were bothering her

cherokee: sgwalahno ganida'dv tla uwasa degvwakehidasdi yigesi tvhgi gvwalidohv'i
english: Since her tail was short, she couldn't swat [chase/go after] the flies that were climbing on her

cherokee: sagwu iga otsatvdvhnv elisi ntsulsdohtanv sgwala ganida'dv'i
english: One day, we asked Grandma how it happened that her tail was short

cherokee: nigadvhno oginoselv'i
english: This is what she told us all

cherokee: ogiduda uhyanvhe usdi nasgi aginagwu gese'i
english: Our grandpa got usdi when she was a young mere

cherokee: nasgihno nitsulsdohtane usdi duno'e'i
english: that's how it happened that they named her Usdi

cherokee: ale eli iyv yudetiyvdv nulstane unisinahvstane akilvdohdi nulstane'i
english: And when she got old enough they tamed her [made her resourceful] and able to be ridden.

cherokee: nasgihno edutsi awinutsa gese iga edolidohi gese
english: And when Uncle was a young man, he was really going around [a lot]

cherokee: Ale Usdi eligwu akilvdodi nulstane, hatlvgwu yuwena, nasgi usdi akilvdisge'i
english: And when Usdi became able to be ridden, whenever he went somewhere, he'd be riding Usdi

cherokee: Gohigi tsigesv, digelisgi danindegv kilo tsuwenvsv ale yigi analsgisge'i ale daninogisge'i
english: A while ago, they'd have pie sales at someone's house, and maybe dances and sings.

cherokee: sagwu svhiyeyv unohehle dinalsgisgv dayesisv'i
english: one night he [Uncle] said he was going to a dance

cherokee: Digvdihwisdi Amayi sgadugi anoseho'i
english: It was what they call Hinton Community (across the creek).

cherokee: iyuhno yinadeyoli nvnohi tso'iha yutliloda gese'i
english: If you go around on the road, it is three miles

cherokee: iyuhno tsiyuktvgwu inage yugalosa [yiwigalosa], otsadisgo, ta'liaha iyutliloda gese'i
english: If you go straight through the woods, we say, it's only two miles.

cherokee: Igahno esgahni gese inage yugalosa [yiwigalosa]
english: It's really less to go through the woods.

cherokee: udvnv'istanehno uhnigisdi utanv ududa unohisele
english: When he was ready to leave, Great Grandpa said this:

cherokee: yidatsehlagwu yitsotlagwu kohi usv'i
english: It would be better if you just were at home tonight

cherokee: Tla osdv yigi edolidasdi kohi usv'i
english: It isn't good to be going around tonight

cherokee: Edutsi uhnigise uwenvse'i
english: Uncle left and went

cherokee: Analsgisgvhno ulsgwada svnoyv ilvh(i)hlv gese
english: When the dance was over, it was about midnight

cherokee: Nogwu di'uhnigise edutsi
english: Then, Uncle left again

cherokee: Tlahno nvnohi yinudeyole
english: He didn't go around on the road

cherokee: Duwuktane tsiyukda inage nidayulohisdi'i
english: He decided to go straight through the woods
